name: CJ Corporation
summary: Operating globally, CJ Corporation is a diversified conglomerate with core interests spanning food and food services, biotechnology, logistics and retail, and entertainment and media. The company's food sector encompasses manufacturing a variety of food products, running dining establishments, and distributing food ingredients, while its bio division supplies amino acids for animal feed and food additive applications. Beyond these, CJ Corporation manages extensive logistics operations and offers comprehensive engineering and construction services for projects such as research and development centers, industrial facilities, offices, commercial buildings, hotels, and golf courses, alongside providing remodeling solutions. It also consults on real estate development, runs health and beauty retail stores, and operates e-commerce platforms. Furthermore, the company furnishes IT systems and services to sectors including manufacturing, distribution, logistics, and media. In its entertainment and media segment, CJ Corporation is a prolific creator of diverse content, including films, music, live performances, animations, conventions, and multi-channel network (MCN) productions. It also operates movie theater chains and provides digital broadcasting services. CJ Corporation was founded in 1953 and maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
